connector.name: Tabular Recipe
connector.registryDescription: Turn any recipe into a compact process table - every ingredient and step at a glance.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.tabularrecipe.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.tabularrecipe, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key for recipe tools. Discovery and checkout tools work without it.
